decisions.reason: The jazz vinyl reissue builds on the firm's established reissue expertise and likely meets its aspiration based on comparable jazz releases, while slack allows keeping it if demand remains uncertain.
The multi-disc box set fits the firm's curated-edition strategy and shows no evidence of falling below the aspiration level relative to similar box sets, so it is retained.
The compilation CD is close to the existing catalog and, given the firm's warehouse-backed slack, can be carried while its performance is still evaluated against the aspiration level.
